card.name: Space before electrolyte lab values
card.fires_on: The space or small symbol just before a number for serum potassium or sodium, such as a threshold or range, in electrolyte and lab-value text. It comes right before units like mEq/L or mmol/L.

modes.label: Before a threshold
modes.description: Space or less-than sign right before a cutoff number for a low electrolyte level.

modes.label: Before a range or amount
modes.description: Space before a numeric range or dose amount in mEq.
